helpInstructions: Listen to an IPA sample first, then choose sounds to practise words. Listen, type the word and press Enter to check; if correct, press Enter again for the next word. Use “Next word” or Alt + → to move on. Revealing the answer first does not count as a correct answer.
helpVoice: British English voices are preferred; your device may use a fallback voice. Library transcriptions do not include stress marks.
datasetNote: A study set of 3,000 A1–B2 entries, including the original 507 words. Levels are a guide for each entry; other meanings may have different levels. This set was compiled for Buffalo Ear and is not the official Oxford 3000 list.
extraEntries: . Some additional entries were compiled separately.
pageTitle: Buffalo Ear — Listen closely. Remember longer.
pageDescription: Practise English listening and spelling with 3,000 A1–B2 words and 44 IPA sounds.
